title: TriggerPayload (Screen Monitoring -> Socratic Educator)
description: Payload Component 1 sends when it detects a screen-content risk. Never includes raw flagged media - only classification metadata, so Component 3 can start a conversation without re-exposing the child to the content.

session_id.description: UUID shared across all 4 components for one incident

context_metadata.description: Non-identifying context only - no raw image/video is ever passed downstream
